crossRefs.note: To the sons of Gershom were given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its pasture…
She bore a son, and he named him Gershom, for he said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land.”
They gave to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the half-tribe of Manasseh Golan in Bashan…

parallels.note: The children of Gershon had thirteen cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, out of the tribe of…

people.name: Asher
people.line: Son of Jacob and Zilpah, founder of the tribe of Asher

people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

people.name: Gershon
people.line: Firstborn son of Levi; head of the Gershonite Levites.

people.name: Issachar
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, forefather of tribe

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

people.name: Naphtali
people.line: Son of Jacob, founder of the tribe of Naphtali.

translations.web: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
translations.bsb: The Gershomites, according to their clans, were allotted thirteen cities from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and Manasseh in Bashan.
translations.kjv: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
translations.asv: And to the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
